text:
ravi: Quick pulse on saffron-3b onboarding for the model-catalog launch — licensing already pinged legal, we have a tokenizer mismatch on staging, and the perf profile isn't finalized. Need runtime + canary owners. @mike @sarah

jenn: I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/862 with the manifest + sample queries. Added notes about tokenizer (it's byte-level BPE) and an optional normalization step.

mike: I can take runtime ownership. Will look at quantization profile — target low-latency p50 ~60ms for shorter responses, but need real perf numbers. @ravi any target SLAs?

sarah: Legal confirmed Apache-2.0 is ok but we need a model card with training dataset attribution. legal-bot flagged missing fields: training_corpora and third_party_attrib. I'll add a template comment in the PR.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: saffron-3b -> group 'model-catalog-canary' at 2024-11-02T09:00Z (ETA).

ravi: Thanks. Two blockers for canary: tokenizer conversion script (where is the canonical one?) and embeddings shape/normalization for similarity search. @jenn did you run embedding sanity?

jenn: Ran embedding smoke locally — dims are 1536 but vector normalization differs from our search pipeline. Pushing a small normalization step to the PR. Snippet:```
# tokenizer conversion
python tools/convert_tokenizer.py --src saffron-tokenizer.json --dst hf_tokenizer
```

vivian: Heads-up from perf: we observed a memory spike on stage when KV-cache warm-up > 4k tokens. Suggest setting model.max_seq to 4096 for the initial canary to avoid OOM on smaller instance types.

mike: Good call. I'll set autoscale min GPUs to 2 for the canary (adds cost but reduces OOM risk) and add a runtime guard for seq_len > 4096.

ravi: Ownership matrix for clarity: runtime = mike, curation = jenn, legal = sarah, perf = vivian, product = ravi. If anyone can't own their area, shout now.

sarah: OK from legal — I'll follow up with the required model card text in PR comments.

jenn: tagging @eng-oncall for a quick config review: https://go/review/CFG-194

alex: Quick CR note: manifest uses "tokenizer": "bytelevel" — our schema expects "byte_level". I'll leave line comments on the PR.

mike: I'll address autoscale + tokenizer mapping today, aim to merge by EOD so canary scheduling can be firmed up.

ravi: If we merge, propose canary start 12:00 UTC 2024-11-03. Anyone object? react with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:.

vivian: :thumbsup:

sarah: :thumbsup:

jenn: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:
